text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, ciprofloxacin hydrochloride is not on the FDA drug shortage list. Inventory across Corvale sites shows variable days on hand. Corvale East 250 mg stock ranges from 18.4 to 29.5 days. Corvale General 250 mg stock ranges from 13.2 to 16.6 days. For 500 mg, Corvale East has 23.2 days, Corvale General has 29 days, and Corvale Lakeside has 25.2 days.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include ciprofloxacin hydrochloride as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current supply is adequate at most sites but Corvale General 250 mg presentations are below 14 days on hand. Proactive purchasing is warranted to prevent a site-level shortage.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, LLC for 250 mg and 500 mg tablets; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Buyer to place orders with Advanced Rx of Tennessee, LLC as a secondary source; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
3. Buyer to evaluate Amneal Pharmaceuticals NY LLC, Aurobindo Pharma Limited, and Bayer HealthCare Pharmaceuticals Inc. for contract pricing; requires P&T Committee approval for formulary addition.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
